title: Pack an allowlist for MCP Dev Summit
excerpt: Linux Foundation MCP Dev Summit is 5–6 October in Toronto. Bring an inventory and a policy page, not a wishlist of Connect buttons.
contentHtml:
Pack an allowlist. MCP Dev Summit (Toronto, 5–6 October 2026) is the first dedicated MCP conference. The agenda is production: Delimarsky on the protocol, TELUS on a year of enterprise registry, talks on workforce-scale governance. The hallway will still try to hand you another connector.

Print five things: every remote URL you already call, session/SSE leftovers, a one-page keep/quarantine/kill list, quality over stars (~12,870 Influzer listings, ~386 with indexed tools), and the sentence that a website is not an MCP server.

Why it matters: a conference without an estate map is a shopping trip. Full packing list: Pack an allowlist for MCP Dev Summit. Pair with policy before plugins and Discovery.
